name: fastify-typescript-server
description: Basic Fastify server written in TypeScript

scripts.migration:generate: npm run build && npm run typeorm -- migration:generate src/migrations/GeneratedMigration -d dist/plugins/database.js
scripts.migration:run: npm run build && npm run typeorm -- migration:run -d dist/plugins/database.js
scripts.migration:revert: npm run build && npm run typeorm -- migration:revert -d dist/plugins/database.js
